Read by lib/pickup-eta.js and lib/pickup-messages.js. Internal file: the distributor is never named in customer text.

rules: A line ordered in rides the next supplier run (Tue, Fri) if it goes to the supplier by the end of the business day before the run. Sent at or after confirm_after_time (14:00) that day, the supplier must confirm: the customer is promised the run after, and readyByIfConfirmed is the earlier date.
Goods reach Sechelt the evening of the run and are ready the next business morning.

Powell River: goods leave Sechelt on the Thursday truck; they must be ready at Sechelt the business day before, and are ready at Powell River the next business morning. A line on the Sechelt shelf ('at_sechelt') only needs the Thursday truck.
The whole order is ready together.
All lines on the pickup location's shelf: ready the same business day if paid before store.same_day_cutoff, else the next business morning.
A holiday closes the store and cancels a run or truck falling on it (the order moves to the next one), unless the holiday row says store_open or truck_runs true.
